Grace drinks tea after doing sports. Grace wants to be a teacher in the future. Both of them like salad and tea. Also, buy a one-way ticket to Leeds.
The train station is one of the best places in the city. Grace hopes to visit Xi'an one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the train station by bike. Ride the clutch gently on hills.
Life is full of small surprises. Grace thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. They took many photos at the travel plan.
